Topic.label: Basic Facts about Lines and Line Segments

Question: Why does a carpenter need to fix only two points when snapping an ink line?

Choices.A: The perpendicular segment is the shortest
Choices.C: The line segment between two points is the shortest path
Choices.D: Through a point outside a line, there is exactly one line parallel to the given line

Solution: Once two points of the ink line are fixed, there is only one line passing through them, so its position is determined. This is based on the fact that “two points determine a line.”

Meta.LabelProvenance: Domain from upstream category; provisional skill from upstream topic, not a formula-level judgment.

Original.prompt: 为什么木工弹墨线只需固定两点？

choices.text: 过直线外一点有且只有一条直线与已知直线平行

Original.explanation: 墨线固定两个点后，经过这两点的直线只有一条，所以位置就确定了，依据是“两点确定一条直线”。
